summary:
Main
Today's weakness extended across futures, port prices and seaborne composite indices. DCE most traded closed at 664.0 yuan/mt,down 1.12%, while the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices fell to 650, 604 and 810 yuan/wmt. The seaborne 61% and 65% indices were USD 88.70 and 106.15/dmt, both down about 0.56%.
